related_questions.question: How much does it cost to get the latest COVID vaccine?
related_questions.snippet: The vaccine is no longer free for most people without insurance. If you don't have health coverage and don't use discounts, you can expect to pay $200 or more for a COVID vaccine. And an administration fee may be added to the cost of your shot. You may be able to save on your COVID vaccine with a GoodRx coupon.

related_questions.question: When is the best time to get a COVID vaccine booster?
related_questions.snippet: The optimal timing for COVID-19 booster administration is highly location-specific but generally falls in early autumn for the Northern Hemisphere. Administering boosters in September or October can provide up to three to four times more protection against infection compared to booster shots given later in the year.
